items.title: What do the recommendations do?
items.text: • Document best practice and recommendations for how to use label, description and tags in AMWA NMOS APIs.

items.title: Why do they matter?
items.text:
• Provide a consistent way of referring to groups of related Resources (e.g. video and audio Senders of a camera)
  • Provide a consistent way of distinguishing between Resources
  • Provide a consistent way of annotating Resources with user information.

items.title: What are the recommendations?
items.text:
• BCP-002-01: Natural Grouping of NMOS Resources
  • BCP-002-02: NMOS Asset Distinguishing Information

items.title: Getting started
items.text:
Start with the recommendation relevant to the resource information being described:

  • BCP-002-01 for grouping related Resources
  • BCP-002-02 for adding human-readable distinguishing information to Resources

There is more information about the NMOS Specifications and their GitHub repos at https://specs.amwa.tv/nmos.

items.title: Introduction
items.text:
AMWA BCP-002 is a series of recommendations for using Annotation Properties (see IS-13) to group, disambiguate and annotated NMOS resources.

For details of the current BCP-002 recommendations see the list of BCPs on the main NMOS page.
